turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have a call at 4:40, so you have until then. Owen found out about a zero on his phone, in the middle of a class, and nobody called me, so start with who decided that.
Before anything else: I entered the zero before I called you. That broke procedure 4.2, and I'm sorry Owen found out on his phone.
Okay. Now tell me what the zero is based on.
Here's the version history. Created Wednesday, October 28, 11:31 PM, title only. At 11:52 PM, 612 words in one edit. At 11:58 PM, 794 more. No earlier drafts. Turn the screen, read it yourself.
I'm writing down 11:31, 11:52 and 11:58. A document he pasted into at night tells you when he pasted it, Hale, not where he wrote it. And was Owen heard before you entered that zero, yes or no?
If he drafted somewhere else, he can bring me that file with its dates, and I'll look at it with you.

You still haven't told me whether you spoke to Owen first, and I'm noting that. Fine, Hale, I've read it. Whatever happens next, this stays off his record and it stays quiet, so tell me what you're proposing.
Second: the essay quotes a line from Act 3, Scene 2 that is not in the play. Here's the act. Search it.
Read me the line exactly as it's in the essay. Students misquote Shakespeare every day, Hale, and editions differ, so which edition is that act from?
Third: his in-class writing from September 24. 380 words in 40 minutes, comma splices, no quotations. The essay has nine quotations cited by act, scene and line, and no errors.

You skipped my question about the edition, and I'll want that line and the edition in writing. Forty minutes in a classroom against an essay he had time to check and revise at home isn't a fair comparison, Hale. I'm writing down September 24, and I'll want to see that piece myself.

Under 4.4 this is a first concern. I'm offering a supervised rewrite, private, not in front of his class. If it shows the learning, its mark replaces the zero and nothing goes on his record. I'll put that in writing tonight.

That's 4.4, and I'll take the rewrite to put this behind him, not because he did anything. Tonight's email says private, supervised, its mark replaces the zero, nothing goes on his record, and you speaking to Owen yourself before it happens. I'll also want the September 24 piece and that line with its edition attached.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

You agreed today to a private, supervised rewrite under procedure 4.4, not in front of his class, whose mark replaces the zero, with nothing placed on Owen's record. I still require that you speak with Owen yourself before the rewrite, and that you send me his September 24 in-class piece and the quoted line with the edition it was checked against. I expect that confirmation in writing tonight, as you said.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: last position; she agreed to a private supervised rewrite under procedure 4.4, and she still wants it confirmed in writing tonight, with you speaking to Owen first and the September piece and the quoted line attached; that is the fair outcome.
What moved her: you showed the version history with its exact times and let her read it, because it was dated, specific, tied to Owen's own file, and she could check it herself.
What cost ground: you never answered whether Owen was heard before the zero, and you moved past her question about the edition, which left two gaps on her pad.
What she never said: in October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your version history put the essay between 11:31 and 11:58 PM on the night before it was due, very close to that kind of night, which is why she went straight to procedure; it proves nothing about the essay, it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: when she asked whether you spoke to Owen before entering the zero, answer that directly in one sentence before showing your next document.
